subject: Pricing follow-up: volumes, budget & startup discount
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: alex.kim@veloxai.com
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing follow-up: volumes, budget & startup discount

Hi Alex — great speaking today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call: 

- Current use case: document understanding + chat for enterprise customers (first pilot with two customers).
- Estimated load: 100–200M tokens / month once pilot scales (you said mid-range ~150M tokens/mo as a likely target).
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile under 300ms for single-request chat flows.
- Data needs: SOC 2 + optional VPC for production; startup can start on hosted API.

A few asks so we can prepare a targeted pricing proposal: 
1) Can you confirm an expected committed monthly token minimum (if any) for year 1 versus burst months?
2) What is your initial monthly budget range for inference (ballpark is fine) — this helps us pick the right committed-use tier versus pay-as-you-go.
3) Any constraints on contract length (12mo vs 24mo) or need for multi-year discounts?

We do have a Startup Program that provides accelerated discounts + credits for early-stage customers; if VeloxAI is eligible we can include a startup package on top of committed-use pricing. I’ve attached my discovery notes from today.

Next steps: 
- If you can reply with the two numbers above (committed tokens / budget range) I’ll share a starter pricing grid and loop in our deals lead for final approval.
- Happy to set a short follow-up next week (15–20 min) to walk the numbers.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: discovery-notes-veloxai.txt (text)

From: alex.kim@veloxai.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: finance@veloxai.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: volumes, budget & startup discount

Thanks Laura — great call. Quick answers below: 

- Committed tokens (year 1 target): ~150M tokens/month. We expect seasonal growth but can commit to a floor of 100M tokens/mo for pricing purposes.
- Budget: our initial pilot budget for infra is ~$20k/month; with production rollout we expect to go to $40–70k/month within 6–9 months.
- Contract length: open to 12-month or 24-month commitments if the economics are right. Multi-year incentives are of interest.

Goal: we’re targeting something roughly in the $200–$350 per 1M tokens range given our current unit economics. Can Redwood match that with a committed-use agreement + startup credits?

If helpful, loop in your deals/ops folks and send a pricing matrix (pay-as-you-go, 12mo commit, 24mo commit) so we can evaluate. Also please call out any caps/exclusions (e.g., KV cache, streaming vs non-streaming unit pricing).

—Alex
Alex Kim | Head of Platform | VeloxAI
alex.kim@veloxai.com | +1 (650) 555-9876

Thanks Alex — super helpful detail. I’m looping in Marissa (deals lead) to validate discount bands and approvals. Preliminary notes below while Marissa reviews: 

Preliminary pricing (starter, subject to final approval):
- Pay-as-you-go: $450 / 1M tokens
- 12mo commit (100M tokens/mo floor): $320 / 1M tokens (approx)
- 12mo commit (150M tokens/mo floor): $290 / 1M tokens
- 24mo commit (150M tokens/mo floor): $250 / 1M tokens + additional 5% multi-year incentive

Startup Program: can provide an additional credit/discount structure for qualifying startups — typically 20–30% applied to the committed tier for the first 6–12 months (or a $X credit). We’ll need a short eligibility check (incorporation date, funding stage).

Notes on what’s included: enterprise features (private deployment options, audit logs, KMS) may carry separate add-ons — the quoted $/1M is for hosted inference (standard throughput). If you need VPC/on-prem that will change the SOW.

Attachments: pricing_proposal_v1.xlsx (proposal grid)

Can you confirm:
- If you can do a 12mo commit to 100–150M tokens / mo, or whether you need the 24mo to get below $300/1M?
- Any legal/procurement timelines we should be aware of?

If you’re ok, I can draft a formal proposal and we’ll route to legal/finance for SOW + DocuSign.

Best,
Laura

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, alex.kim@veloxai.com
Cc:

Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: volumes, budget & startup discount (Approved: provisional discounts)

Laura / Alex — looping in final numbers and approval from deals. Per our internal review: 

Approved (provisional) commercial options for VeloxAI (subject to SOW & legal):
1) Startup Program + 12mo commit:
   - Eligibility: pre-Series B or <$10M ARR and <36 months since incorporation (VeloxAI to confirm).
   - Offer: 30% off the 12mo committed tier for the first 12 months + $10k platform credit applied to first invoice.
   - Example: 12mo commit at 150M tokens/mo -> list $290/1M -> after 30% startup discount = $203/1M for first 12 months.

2) 12mo committed-use (no startup program):
   - 150M tokens/mo floor -> $290 / 1M tokens (finalized upon PO).

3) 24mo committed-use (multi-year incentive):
   - 150M tokens/mo floor -> $250 / 1M tokens + additional 5% discount applied in year 2 (effective blended ~ $237.50/1M).

Notes & constraints:
- Pricing above is for hosted inference. If VeloxAI requires VPC/private deployment or custom throughput SLAs, those are add-ons and will be scoped in the SOW.
- Credits/discounts are forfeited if the customer terminates early without agreed buyout terms.
- Final legal terms to be provided via SOW/DocuSign link.

Attachments: approved_startup_terms.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/VELX-2027-0421, https://www.docusign.com/en/link/VELX-SOW-2027

Next steps: 
- Alex: confirm startup eligibility (incorporation date + funding stage) and whether you want the 12mo startup package or 24mo multi-year.
- Laura: prepare SOW + pricing sheet (I’ll review final doc before sending to VeloxAI legal).

Happy to jump on a quick sync if needed this week.
